hooks.command: context=$(AOMS_AGENT_ID=claude AOMS_WORKSPACE="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" cortex-mem recall --task "Project context for ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}: current goals, decisions, constraints, failures, and reusable procedures" --budget 2000 --format markdown) || exit 0; [ -n "$context" ] || exit 0; jq -nc --arg context "$context" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$context}}'
